note: Saturday AM refresh, Week 12. Loveland headed to IR with a knee sprain (Roush updated, still a pass); Pittsburgh threw 15 times in the Black Friday win. Kyle Pitts Sr. added as an avoid.

targets.hook: 25% target share in Week 11

targets.hook: Barkley stinger, hand concern; Shipley took over
targets.why: Saquon Barkley left Thanksgiving at Dallas with a stinger after five carries for seven yards and did not return; sideline video appeared to show him gesturing at his left hand, though the Eagles confirmed only the stinger (Yahoo, Nov. 26). Shipley took most of the carries the rest of the way. Barkley had already left the Pittsburgh game five days earlier favoring the same arm.
targets.asset: The Eagles' lead back for as long as Barkley is out; a handcuff otherwise.
targets.rate_basis: usage-recent wk 11: snap 36%, touch share 9% (4 touches); Thanksgiving not final in the file yet
targets.my_team_impact: A bench stash only: Taylor, Irving and Jeanty start, with Tuten at FLEX. Becomes a FLEX option for you if Barkley misses time and Tuten's ankle lingers.
targets.confidence_why: Value rests on an undiagnosed Barkley injury; his own usage line is one week of handcuff snaps.
targets.competition: Barkley's owner and any RB-thin rival will look at him before Tuesday.

targets.hook: Tuten ruled out; Allen is JAX RB3 behind ENOTS' Rodriguez
targets.why: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle, foot) is ruled out for Sunday after missing all three practices (Jaguars.com Friday Quick Hits, Nov. 27). Chris Rodriguez Jr., Ameer Abdullah and Allen are the active backs, and Coen said the whole room has to give them the hard yards. Rodriguez is rostered by ENOTS.
targets.asset: A change-of-pace back with no established touches; only valuable if Tuten sits and Allen gets real work behind Rodriguez.

targets.my_team_impact: Would not start for you. He is the only Jaguars back left on the wire to cover Tuten, but his usage says Rodriguez, not Allen, takes the carries.
targets.confidence_why: Under 20% of snaps with almost no touches; a three-way split behind Rodriguez is the likeliest outcome.
targets.bid: pass; a free add at most if you want a Tuten placeholder for one week.

targets.why: Hurst caught 5 of 7 for 56 yards and two touchdowns at Detroit, his snap share rose to 64%, and the team said it plans to feature him more (Yahoo, Nov. 24). RotoWire called the scores late and semi-fluky.
targets.asset: A rising third receiver with red-zone looks while Jalen McMillan is out.

targets.hook: Rudolph threw 15 passes Friday; Pittman back
targets.why: Bernard caught 6 of 10 targets for 40 yards against Philadelphia after DK Metcalf was ejected (CBS Sports, Nov. 24). Pittsburgh benched Aaron Rodgers for Mason Rudolph on Friday, and Michael Pittman Jr. is expected back from IR for the same game (Yahoo, NFL.com, Nov. 24-25). On Black Friday Mason Rudolph threw only 15 passes (9 of 15, 142 yards, one TD to DK Metcalf) in a 27-5 win led by the defense (ESPN, Nov. 27), so the Pittsburgh passing volume behind Metcalf and Pittman is thin.
targets.asset: Fourth receiver once Pittman returns, with a backup quarterback throwing.

targets.my_team_impact: Does not start for you.
targets.confidence_why: Usage came from an ejection, and the room gets more crowded Friday.

But he has 29 catches for 270 yards in 10 games and has been used heavily as a blocker (SI, Nov. 2026).

Nothing in his usage yet says the targets follow the snaps.

targets.confidence_why: Two final weeks as a blocking backup; the vacancy is real but no target growth has shown up yet.
targets.competition: Fourth on Sleeper adds in the last 24 hours on the Loveland news.
